steps.warmUp: Start with the warm-up, as in every singing lesson: a few easy minutes to wake up your voice.
steps.steps: Most melodies move by steps: from one note to the next one up or down the scale, like do, re, mi. Do is the first note, wherever it falls in your voice. Sing the steps on their names or on “lah”, and this time go straight from note to note instead of sliding.
steps.doReMi: Do, re, mi, and back down. The music waits at each note.
steps.upAndDown: Listen, then sing it in time: do, re, mi, then mi, re, do.
